question: A drop-test laboratory needs the net energy figure, in kJ, for its quarterly accounts. The trolley on one rig is brought up to speed by a numbered sequence of pushes: push number k adds k m/s, and the pushes run from k = 1 through k = 5, so the trolley leaves the last push at the accumulated speed. The trolley has a mass of 5 kg, and the hall around it is kept at 19 degrees C. The trolley's energy of motion at that speed is expressed in kilojoules and doubled, because the laboratory owns 2 identical rigs. It is doubled again for the 2 shifts that were run. Finally the chiller's draw of 22 kJ is subtracted from that total. What is the laboratory's net figure, in kJ?

A press shop is commissioning a new feed drive. The feed carriage's rate of change of speed a, in m/s^2, is the larger value satisfying a^2 - 11a + 24 = 0. The carriage has a mass of 160 kg, and the drive supplies exactly the force required to produce that motion. The commissioning sheet records this force in kilonewtons. The shop runs 5 identical feed drives, and a fixed counterweight of 17 kN pulls against their combined effort. What net figure, in kN, goes on the commissioning sheet?

A quarry contractor needs the final rated pull, in newtons, for a conveyor take-up installation. The base ramp rate r, in m/s^2, is the smaller value satisfying r^2 - 9r + 8 = 0, and the gearing is such that the take-up carriage sees 10 times that rate. The carriage has a mass of 164000 g, and the gearbox oil sits at 45 degrees C. Each drive supplies exactly the force needed to produce the carriage's motion, and the contractor operates 11 identical take-up units. A guide seal absorbs 23 N of the combined pull, and a return spring absorbs a further 25 N. What is the final rated pull, in N?

A CNC shop is checking the drive on a cutting head. The head's speed along the rail is, in metres per second, 3*t^3 - 2*t^2 with t in seconds, and the coolant supply sits at 12 degrees C throughout. The shop is interested in the instant t = 3 s, when the head has a mass of 14 kg and the drive supplies exactly the force needed to produce the head's rate of change of speed at that moment. A magnetic counterbalance takes 13 N off that force. Each machine carries 5 identical heads, and the shop owns 3 identical machines. What total force, in N, do the shop's drives supply?

A sports-science lab wants the final entry, in kilojoules, on one page of its energy ledger. A treadmill belt's speed follows, in metres per second, 1*t^3 + 2*t^2 with t in seconds, and the technicians differentiate that speed 2 times and read the result at the instant t = 1 s. The control system then launches a test sled at a speed, in metres per second, numerically equal to that result. The sled has a mass of 9000 g, and its energy of motion is written into the ledger in kilojoules. The lab ran 2 identical launches that day. An 8 kJ line for the heater and a 7 kJ line for the lighting are then added to the same page. What is the final entry, in kJ?

A test track logs the energy of a series of sled launches. The sled's launch speed, in metres per second, is the sum of the run numbers k from k = 1 up to k = 8, because each run adds its own number in metres per second to the sled. The sled has a mass of 47000 g, and its energy of motion at launch is what the log records for one launch. The track performs 10 identical launches in a session. A pre-charged latch then contributes 13 J to the session total, and a trigger coil contributes a further 2 J. What total energy, in J, does the session record?

A shipyard needs the total pull, in kilonewtons, on a winch gantry. The base rate a, in m/s^2, is the smaller value satisfying a^2 - 9a + 18 = 0, and the gearbox multiplies that base rate by 5. A control offset then adds 17 to the geared figure, giving the carriage's actual rate of change of speed in m/s^2. The carriage has a mass of 14000 g, and each winch supplies exactly the force needed to produce that motion. The gantry carries 9 identical winches working together. What total pull, in kN, does the gantry carry?

A skate-park engineer is instrumenting a trolley on a straight run. The trolley's speed v, in m/s, is the larger value that satisfies v^2 - 12v + 32 = 0. The trolley has a mass of 6000 g, and its energy of motion at that speed is measured at the end of the run. A rolling loss of 29 J is then subtracted from the measurement. The run is repeated with 6 identical trolleys, and the engineer wants their combined corrected energy. What is that combined figure, in kJ?

A crane maker wants the total drive force, in newtons, for a whole installed fleet. Each hoist's rate of change of speed, in m/s^2, is the sum of the whole numbers from 1 up to 12, one for each of its numbered gear steps. The hoist drum assembly has a mass of 164 kg, and the machine room is kept at 26 degrees C. Each hoist supplies exactly the force needed to produce that motion, a tower carries 12 identical hoists, and a fixed rigging allowance of 30 N is taken off the tower's combined force. A site has 10 identical towers, and the maker has completed 12 identical sites. What is the fleet's total drive force, in N?

A cable-drum test bench runs a loaded shuttle back and forth along a rail. The shuttle's speed v, in m/s, is the larger value that satisfies v^2 - 9v + 20 = 0. The shuttle has a mass of 15 kg, and the energy it carries by virtue of its motion is logged for each pass. The bench makes 8 passes in a run, and the log expresses a run's total in kilojoules. The site operates 9 identical benches, and the company owns 9 identical sites. What total energy, in kJ, does the company have in motion at that moment?

A quarry laboratory releases a runaway trolley down a sloped rail. The trolley's release speed v, in m/s, is the larger value that satisfies v^2 - 8v + 7 = 0. The trolley has a mass of 55000 g, and the rail is kept at 15 degrees C during the test. The energy the trolley carries by virtue of its motion at release is expressed in kilojoules, and the laboratory releases 3 identical trolleys in each test. A trigger spring contributes a further 1 kJ to the test's combined figure. The laboratory's fixed instrument allowance of 28 kJ is then subtracted. What is the laboratory's net figure, in kJ?

A bottling plant needs the final entry, in kilojoules, on the energy sheet for one filling head. The head's ram is driven up to speed by 5 identical cam strokes, and each stroke contributes 7 m/s on the push and a further 4 m/s on the release. The ram has a mass of 2 kg and meets the cap at the accumulated speed. A seal absorbs 5 J from the ram's energy of motion at each impact. The head makes 9 impacts in a cycle, and the sheet expresses the cycle total in kilojoules. A metering valve then draws 4 kJ, which is subtracted from that figure. What is the final entry, in kJ?

A rolling mill is commissioning a new entry guide. The guide carriage's rate of change of speed a, in m/s^2, is the smaller value satisfying a^2 - 13a + 40 = 0. The carriage has a mass of 48000 g, and the drive supplies exactly the force needed to produce that motion. A pre-load screw adds a constant 1 N to that force, and the commissioning sheet expresses the result in kilonewtons. One stand carries 12 identical carriages, and the mill has 6 identical stands. What total force, in kN, does the mill's entry section carry?

A conveyor supplier holds 7 different roller types in stock and must fit 4 of them to a trial belt. The engineer first counts the number of distinct sets of 4 roller types that could be drawn from the 7. Of those sets, 3 are rejected because they mix incompatible bearings. The trial sled is then run at a speed, in metres per second, numerically equal to the number of sets still allowed. The sled has a mass of 31000 g, and the energy it carries by virtue of that motion is expressed in kilojoules. The supplier runs 4 identical trial sleds together. What total energy, in kJ, do the sleds carry?

A haulage firm is rating a new trailer brake rig. The rig builds its retardation in 2 identical phases, and each phase contributes 9 m/s^2 while the shoes bite and a further 13 m/s^2 while they lock, so the trailer's overall rate of change of speed is the accumulated figure. The trailer has a mass of 148 kg, and the rig must apply exactly the force that produces that motion. Each rig tests 2 trailers side by side, every depot runs 11 such rigs, and the firm has 10 identical depots. What total force, in kN, does the firm's fleet of rigs apply?

A shipyard needs the total pull, in kilonewtons, from one winch bank. Each winch drum spins up in 4 identical stages, and every stage contributes 6 m/s^2 while the clutch engages and a further 7 m/s^2 while it drives, giving the drum carriage's overall rate of change of speed. The carriage has a mass of 113 kg, and a winch supplies exactly the force needed to produce that motion. Every frame carries 2 such carriages, so a frame's load is 2 times a single carriage's force, and a fixed rigging pre-load of 12 N is then added to each frame. The bank contains 11 identical frames. What total pull, in kN, does the bank carry?

A gearbox workshop needs the net stored figure, in kilojoules, for one afternoon. Two index wheels on the bench carry 292 teeth and 363 teeth, and the setter needs the largest whole number that divides both tooth counts exactly. The test slider is then run at a speed, in metres per second, numerically equal to that number; it has a mass of 50 kg, and the bench is held at 17 degrees C. The energy the slider carries by virtue of its motion is expressed in kilojoules, and the bench runs 9 sliders at a time. The afternoon covers 6 identical sessions, and a standing instrument draw of 19 kJ is then subtracted from the total. What is the net stored figure, in kJ?

A steelworks is commissioning a tilting-table drive. The table's rate of change of speed a, in m/s^2, is the smaller value satisfying a^2 - 11a + 24 = 0. The table has a mass of 169 kg, the pit below it is kept at 28 degrees C, and the drive supplies exactly the force needed to produce that motion. The commissioning sheet expresses that force in kilonewtons. A hydraulic pre-load adds 26 kN and a counterweight chain adds a further 7 kN to the sheet's figure. A guide roller then relieves 19 kN of the total. What figure, in kN, goes on the commissioning sheet?

A theme-park engineer is checking a launch car on a straight section of track. The car's launch speed v, in m/s, is the larger value that satisfies v^2 - 7v + 6 = 0. The car has a mass of 21000 g, and the track surface is at 26 degrees C on the day of the test. The engineer measures the energy the car carries by virtue of its motion and multiplies it by the 3 cars that launch together. From that combined figure 24 J is deducted for the launch-fin drag, and the result is expressed in kilojoules. The park operates 2 identical launch tracks. What total energy, in kJ, do the park's tracks hold at launch?

A laboratory needs the final figure, in kilojoules, for a sled trial. The sled's position along its rail is, in metres, 1*t^3 - 2*t^2 with t in seconds, and the hall is kept at 18 degrees C. The trial is scored at the instant t = 4 s, when the sled has a mass of 4 kg and moves at whatever speed its position curve then gives. The energy the sled carries by virtue of that motion is expressed in kilojoules, and the laboratory runs 8 identical sleds. A fixed rig overhead of 16 kJ is subtracted from the combined figure, and the whole trial is repeated on 7 identical days. What is the final figure, in kJ?

A cycle-testing bench accelerates a dummy rider along a short rail. The rail's base speed b, in m/s, is the smaller value that satisfies b^2 - 6*b + 5 = 0, and a tail fan then adds a further 14 m/s, so the dummy leaves the rail at the combined speed. The dummy has a mass of 44000 g. The energy it carries by virtue of that motion is measured at the end of the rail. A pre-charged latch contributes a further 18 J to the reading. What is the total, in kJ?

A tunnelling machine's thrust ring is being rated. The ring's rate of change of speed, in m/s^2, is the sum of the whole numbers from 1 up to 5, one for each of its numbered pressure stages. The moving ring has a mass of 142000 g, and the rams supply exactly the force needed to produce that motion. A guide shoe relieves 9 N of that force, and the rating sheet expresses the result in kilonewtons. The machine carries 9 identical thrust rings. What total thrust, in kN, does the machine's rating sheet show?

A robot arm's linear axis is being commissioned. The slide's speed along the axis is, in metres per second, 1*t^3 - 2*t^2 with t in seconds. The commissioning point is the instant t = 2 s, at which the slide has a mass of 125000 g and the drive supplies exactly the force needed to produce the slide's rate of change of speed. The commissioning sheet expresses that force in kilonewtons. The cell contains 3 identical arms working together, and a fixed counterweight of 5 kN pulls against their combined effort. What net figure, in kN, goes on the sheet?

A materials laboratory wants the final total, in kilojoules, from a fatigue campaign. The hammer's position along its guide is, in metres, 2*t^3 + 3*t^2 with t in seconds, and the campaign is scored at the instant t = 2 s. At that instant the hammer has a mass of 25 kg and moves at whatever speed its position curve gives. From the energy the hammer carries by virtue of that motion, 30 J is subtracted for guide friction, and the corrected figure is expressed in kilojoules. The rig strikes 8 times in a cycle, and the campaign covers 12 identical cycles. What is the final total, in kJ?

A dockside gantry is being load-tested. The gantry trolley builds its rate of change of speed in 3 identical steps, and each step contributes 2 m/s^2 as the clutch takes up and a further 2 m/s^2 as it drives. The trolley has a mass of 91 kg, the machinery house is kept at 23 degrees C, and the drive supplies exactly the force needed to produce the trolley's motion. Each gantry runs 4 identical trolleys, and the load-test sheet expresses a gantry's combined force in kilonewtons. The dock has 6 identical gantries. What total force, in kN, does the dock's gantry fleet apply?
